mentions.name: Frost
mentions.description: A simple self-hosted deployment platform that is Docker-only, single-user, and avoids Kubernetes. Users point it at a repo or container image and it handles the full flow: build, health check, deploy, and stopping the old container. Built with Bun, Next.js, SQLite, and Kysely.
